name: koa-static
description: Static file serving middleware for koa

scripts.build: npm run build:cjs && npm run build:esm
scripts.build:cjs: tsc && node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); fs.writeFileSync('dist/cjs/index.cjs', \"module.exports = require('./index.js').default;\"); fs.writeFileSync('dist/cjs/index.d.cts', \"import serve from './index.js'; export = serve;\")"
scripts.build:esm: tsc --module ES2022 --moduleResolution Bundler --outDir dist/esm && node -e "require('node:fs').writeFileSync('dist/esm/package.json', JSON.stringify({ type: 'module' }))"
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/unit/index.test.ts test/integration/static.test.ts
scripts.test-cov: npm run build && node --test --experimental-test-coverage test/unit/index.test.ts test/integration/static.test.ts
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
